# logcut v0.1.21

## Changes

- Warn when a successful command log cannot be deleted.
- Attempt best-effort secret masking and terminal-control sanitization before leaving a log behind after a cleanup failure.
- Warn clearly when both cleanup and sanitization fail and unsafe log content may remain.
- Remove terminal escape sequences and unsafe control characters from retained failure logs.
- Update regression coverage for retained logs containing invalid UTF-8 and control bytes.

## Compatibility

- Existing commands, profiles, exit-code behavior, and retention settings are unchanged.
- Successful command logs are still removed during normal operation.
- Retained logs may differ by having terminal escape sequences and unsafe control characters removed.
